content: Images (including GIFs) are the top driver of poor Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) on 85% of desktop pages and 76% of mobile pages. An unoptimized hero GIF (e.g. 8MB) can dominate total page weight and add multiple seconds of load time on mobile connections. Improperly sized/undeclared-dimension GIFs also cause Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS), and large images needing decode can hurt Interaction to Next Paint (INP) responsiveness. Multiple heavy autoplaying GIFs on one page compound all three Core Web Vitals problems simultaneously.
